{{Quote|Will she fly?"<br />"She's not pretty, but she's tough.|[[Kao Cen Darach]] and [[Nico Okarr]]|<ref name="Return (cinematic trailer)">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/return|text="Return"|int=Return (cinematic trailer)}}</ref>}}
The '''''Redshifter''''' was a [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]] owned by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Nico Okarr]] during the years before the [[Great Galactic War]]. He claimed it was the "fastest ship in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|sector]]".
